title: Low End-to-End Latency atop a Speculative Shared Log with Fix-Ante Ordering
problem: Shared log-based systems for distributed databases face latency challenges due to coordination overhead and ordering requirements; speculative execution can reduce latency but requires robust ordering guarantees.
motivation: Reducing end-to-end latency in replicated systems enables lower latency transaction processing without sacrificing consistency.
method: Introduces Fix-Ante ordering mechanism with speculative shared log to achieve low latency while maintaining consistency guarantees in distributed systems.
key_novelty: Fix-Ante ordering scheme enabling speculative execution with correctness guarantees for low-latency shared log systems.
contributions: Fix-Ante ordering protocol for speculative execution
Low end-to-end latency without sacrificing consistency
limitations: Effectiveness depends on speculation accuracy; high contention scenarios may reduce benefits.
primary_theme: Speculative shared log for low latency
